title: Plastic Recycling is an Actual Scam | Climate Town
summary: Climate Town gives a comedic, fast-paced account of how the plastics industry promoted recycling, including the resin-code recycling symbol, while knowing most plastic could not be economically recycled. It points viewers to the Frontline documentary Plastic Wars for a deeper treatment.
why: Commenters send it as a short, entertaining explanation of why people believe plastic is recyclable and how industry PR created that belief.

quote.text: This video is under 10mins and features a lot of the PR adverts.
